# dsh-skill-experts
English | 中文
Manage **skill experts** in the sidebar and summon them in chat for specialized work. Community Deep
Seek Harness plugin — not an official DeepSeek AI product.
First launch includes four built-ins: Frontend Developer, Product Manager, UI Designer, and Copywrit
st launch includes four built-ins: Frontend Developer, Product Manager, UI Designer, and Copywriter.
## What it does

- Create, edit, enable, or disable experts in the sidebar
- Give each expert a description, persona,

and skills; import / export expert packages
- Summon from the composer **Skill experts** button or

`@` mention
- **Continue** (on by default): summoning the same expert again in this chat picks up wh

ere you left off; turn it off for a fresh start. Each chat remembers its own setting
- Or set an ena
bled expert as the session Agent when you want that expert to lead the whole conversation

## How to use

1. Create or enable experts in the sidebar; write a clear **description** (when to use them)
2. In c
hat, click **Skill experts** or `@` pick one — or just describe the task so a matching description c

an auto-summon
3. Send; the main chat summons the expert and summarizes the result
4. Leave **Contin

ue** on to keep talking with the same expert; turn it off for a clean slate
5. To let one expert lea
d the whole session, choose them as the session Agent
